title: Observatório do Custo Brasil
description: Monitoring structural inefficiencies in Brazil’s economy — taxes, bureaucracy, and logistics barriers for businesses and society.
body:
I contributed to the Observatório do Custo Brasil, a platform dedicated to analyzing and monitoring the economic challenges facing Brazil. This initiative provides valuable insights into how structural inefficiencies in the country's economy — such as high taxes, bureaucracy, and logistical barriers — impact businesses and society as a whole.

The observatory serves as a critical resource for policymakers, businesses, and citizens to understand and address the factors that contribute to Brazil's high cost of doing business.
